title: Try-Out Challenge
intro: Hi Joshua! It's me, Steve. Let's do a challenge together. I'll ask you some questions. Tap an answer to hear it, then tap it again to pick it. Ready? Here we go!
outro: You did it! You finished the whole challenge. I'm so proud of you. You earned a trophy!

questions.subject: math
questions.say: How many apples are there? Count them with me, then tap the number.

questions.subject: phonics
questions.say: Which one starts with the sound buh, like ball? Tap it.

questions.subject: logic
questions.say: Look at the pattern. Star, moon, star, moon, star. What comes next?

questions.subject: reading
questions.say: Now it's your turn to read! Tap the big red button, read the word out loud, then tap it again when you're done.

questions.subject: reading
questions.say: Here is a sentence. Tap the red button and read it out loud to me. If you don't know a word, try to sound it out.

questions.subject: logic
questions.say: Which one does not belong with the others? Tap it.
questions.why: Good thinking! Can you tell me why? Tap the red button and tell me, then tap it again when you're done.
